text: A23FONT PRODUCTION MANDATE: Implement, test, deploy, productionise private web app A23Font end-to-end. Flow: user opens https://font.esma.eu.org -> submits supported myfonts.com collection/family URL (+optional Vietnamese extension) -> persistent job -> styles discovered -> fonts reconstructed per fast15.md -> validated -> TTF+OTF -> ZIP with reports -> download. Production machine = real Samsung Galaxy A23 (per a23-server repo: Docker 20.10 in Debian chroot, token-managed cloudflared tunnel on Termux host). fast15.md is authoritative pipeline spec; A23 is performance authority. Stack v1: Python/FastAPI/server-rendered HTML/SQLite/one worker/Docker Compose; portable /data state root; no React/Redis/Postgres/Celery. Reuse existing Cloudflare tunnel; PUBLIC_BASE_URL=https://font.esma.eu.org. Security: URL allowlist myfonts.com only, SSRF protection, safe filenames, unguessable IDs, worker not public, no secrets in git/images/outputs. Gates 1-13 as in mandate; reboot tests only with human authorization. Deliverables: app source, UI, adapter, pipeline, job system, cache/recovery, TTF/OTF, validation, ZIP, cancel, crash recovery, Docker ARM64, compose, .env.example, health endpoints, tests, structured logs, backup/restore/migration/rollback docs, A23 benchmarks, a23-server scoped integration, Cloudflare wiring, verified production operation.
